author: Reydan2A
quote: Pokémon Violet has some great qualities that make it an enjoyable adventure. The Pokédex is full of interesting new Pokémon, the characters are surprisingly well-written, and the three separate storylines eventually come together in a satisfying conclusion. The soundtrack is also a real highlight, with some memorable tracks that make exploring Paldea even more enjoyable. Unfortunatly, the game is seriously held back by its graphics, technical issues and terrible optimization. Frame drops, visual glitches and poor performance are simply unacceptable for a major Nintendo release. Considering its full retail price, these problems are even harder to forgive.

author: Reydan2A
quote: Pokémon Legends: Arceus is one of the most refreshing entries in the franchise. Its new approach to exploration and Pokémon catching makes the experience incredibly immersive and addictive. The freedom to explore Hisui, encounter Pokémon in the wild and complete the Pokédex in new ways brings a much-needed evolution to the series. The story and atmosphere also make the adventure particularly enjoyable. The only real disappointment is the graphics, which feel outdated, with poor textures and a lack of visual detail. However, this doesn’t take away much from the overall experience. With its innovative gameplay, rewarding exploration and fresh take on the Pokémon formula, Arceus is exactly the change the franchise needed.

author: Reydan2A
quote: Watch Dogs: Legion had an interesting concept with its “play as anyone” mechanic and a beautifully recreated London. However, this ambitious idea quickly becomes its biggest weakness. Without a main protagonist, the story lacks emotional depth, and most characters feel generic and forgettable. The gameplay also feels like a recycled version of previous entries, with little innovation beyond the recruitment system. Missions quickly become repetitive, dialogue is often disappointing, and the overall experience lacks the personality that made Watch Dogs 2 so enjoyable. While the hacking mechanics and open world remain decent, they aren’t enough to save the game from its many shortcomings.

author: Reydan2A
quote: Watch Dogs 2 is a great improvement over its predecessor, offering a vibrant and detailed recreation of San Francisco. Its biggest strength is its hacking-based gameplay, which provides plenty of freedom and creative ways to approach missions. The characters are entertaining, and the mix of humor, exploration and action makes the experience genuinely enjoyable. However, the story sometimes lacks depth, and certain missions can feel repetitive. Vehicle handling could also be improved. Despite these flaws, its engaging gameplay, lively open world and freedom of approach make it a highly enjoyable game that deserves a solid 8/10.

author: Reydan2A
quote: Fallout 4 is an incredibly immersive RPG with a fascinating post-apocalyptic world, memorable locations and outstanding environmental storytelling. Exploring the Commonwealth, discovering its secrets and building settlements makes every playthrough rewarding. The atmosphere and soundtrack are fantastic, and the freedom to shape your own adventure is addictive. The dialogue system and some RPG mechanics are weaker than in previous entries, but the overall experience remains exceptional.

author: Reydan2A
quote: Minecraft is one of the most creative and timeless games ever made. Its limitless freedom, endless possibilities and simple yet incredibly deep gameplay make every adventure unique. Whether you’re building incredible structures, exploring vast worlds, surviving or playing with friends, there’s always something new to experience. Few games offer so much freedom and have remained relevant for so long. A true gaming phenomenon.

author: Reydan2A
quote: Hades is an absolute masterpiece of roguelike design. Its fast-paced combat, incredible weapon variety and perfectly balanced progression make every escape attempt exciting and rewarding. The art direction is gorgeous, the soundtrack is phenomenal and the characters are brought to life through some of the best dialogue and storytelling in the genre. Even failure feels meaningful, as every attempt reveals more about the world and its inhabitants. A perfect blend of gameplay, narrative and replayability.

author: Reydan2A
quote: Skyrim is the definition of an unforgettable RPG. Its incredible world, freedom of exploration and endless possibilities make every playthrough feel like a unique adventure. Whether you’re exploring ancient ruins, joining guilds, slaying dragons or simply getting lost in the wilderness, there’s always something waiting around the corner. Its atmosphere, soundtrack and world-building are absolutely phenomenal. Even with its flaws, few games have managed to capture that same feeling of adventure and freedom. A game you can return to hundreds of hours later and still discover something new.

author: Reydan2A
quote: Super Mario Odyssey is pure joy from beginning to end. Its creative worlds, fantastic level design and incredibly satisfying gameplay make exploration an absolute pleasure. Cappy adds a brilliant new dimension to Mario’s abilities, encouraging experimentation and rewarding curiosity.Every kingdom feels unique, packed with secrets and memorable moments. The soundtrack is wonderful, and the game constantly finds new ways to surprise you.A few repetitive collectibles keep it from absolute perfection, but this is still one of Mario’s finest adventures.

author: Reydan2A
quote: I expected Tears of the Kingdom to be even better than Breath of the Wild, and somehow, it delivered. Building upon an already incredible foundation, Nintendo managed to create an even richer, deeper and more ambitious adventure. The new abilities completely transform exploration and gameplay, offering an incredible level of creativity and freedom. The world feels bigger, the discoveries are even more rewarding, and the soundtrack perfectly captures the magic and emotion of the journey. A remarkable achievement that takes everything that made its predecessor special and pushes it even further.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition

author: Reydan2A
quote: I genuinely thought Ocarina of Time would never be equalled. Yet Breath of the Wild managed to achieve something I never expected : reaching that same level of greatness through an entirely different kind of adventure. Its incredible open world, freedom of exploration, breathtaking soundtrack and constant sense of discovery make every journey memorable. Hyrule feels alive, and every mountain, ruin and hidden secret invites you to explore ****’s a brilliant reinvention of Zelda that never loses the magic of the series.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

author: Reydan2A
quote: We were expecting Skyrim in space, an epic RPG where exploration and discovery would be at the heart of the experience. Unfortunately, Starfield never quite delivers on that promise. The universe feels surprisingly empty, exploration quickly becomes repetitive, and the countless loading screens break immersion. Despite some interesting quests and decent character customisation, the writing and world-building rarely reach the standards Bethesda has set with its previous games. There are some enjoyable moments, but the experience lacks the magic and freedom that made Skyrim so memorable.

author: Reydan2A
quote: Umamusume is a surprisingly addictive and charming experience. Its unique mix of horse racing, character training and management creates a deeply satisfying gameplay loop. The characters are full of personality, and the music, presentation and racing sequences are fantastic. What’s even better is everything surrounding the game. It encourages players to discover the stories of real racehorses, their achievements and rivalries, while raising awareness of the real-world horse racing industry and its animal welfare issues. The only downside is that not pulling a new trainee can seriously reduce the motivation to keep grinding.Still, an incredibly original game with much more depth than meets the eye.

author: Reydan2A
quote: I’ve been playing Dokkan Battle for 11 years, and it genuinely hurts to give it such a low score. The original formula was simple, addictive and incredibly enjoyable, with a huge variety of characters and some of the best illustrations in the Dragon Ball franchise. But modern monetisation has gone way too far. Daily Dragon Stones, battle passes, extremely powerful artefacts locked behind RNG systems, and a pity system requiring 20 multis that are paid-only and don’t carry over between banners. At this point, it feels less like a game and more like an endless attempt to squeeze money out of its most dedicated players. The worst part is that the game doesn’t even seem to stand on its own anymore. It survives largely through anniversary and worldwide celebration hype, with very little excitement outside these major events. After 11 years of loyalty, this is genuinely disappointing. The foundations were excellent, but the monetisation has slowly overshadowed everything that made Dokkan special.

author: Reydan2A
quote: BLEACH: Soul Resonance is a fantastic adaptation that shows genuine love and respect for the original franchise. The beautiful graphics, anime-inspired soundtrack and faithful character designs make every battle a pleasure to experience. The progression system is intuitive and easy to understand, while the incredibly generous gacha makes collecting characters enjoyable rather than frustrating. Farming automation is another welcome feature, allowing players to focus on the fun instead of endless grinding. A love letter to BLEACH fans and a great gacha experience. Hopefully, a console release will come someday !

author: Reydan2A
quote: Genshin Impact offers a fantastic adventure with a beautiful world to explore, an engaging story, memorable characters and an absolutely outstanding soundtrack. Its exploration and world-building are easily among its greatest strengths.Unfortunately, the aggressive and rather stingy gacha system, repetitive daily activities and excessive grinding for character progression can become frustrating. The limited stamina system doesn’t help either.Despite these flaws, there’s a genuinely wonderful RPG hidden behind its monetisation.

author: Reydan2A
quote: Pokémon Legends: Z-A is a massive disappointment. The gameplay quickly becomes repetitive, the world feels limited and lifeless, and the overall experience lacks the depth and ambition expected from the **** only real highlight is the cast of secondary characters, who bring some personality and charm to an otherwise underwhelming adventure.A disappointing Pokémon experience that struggles to justify its existence.

author: Reydan2A
quote: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is an absolute masterpiece. Its breathtaking art direction, incredible soundtrack and emotionally powerful story create an unforgettable **** characters are wonderfully written, the world is fascinating to explore and the combat system brilliantly combines classic turn-based RPG mechanics with real-time action. Every encounter feels engaging, and the music alone is worth the journey.A unique artistic achievement that proves video games can be just as powerful as cinema.

author: Reydan2A
quote: Dragon Quest IX is everything a classic JRPG should be. Its charming world, beautiful art direction and memorable soundtrack create an adventure that’s incredibly easy to fall in love **** character creation, extensive class system, equipment customisation and turn-based combat offer an almost endless amount of possibilities. Add hundreds of quests, treasure maps and local multiplayer, and you have a game capable of keeping you entertained for dozens, if not hundreds, of **** what makes Dragon Quest IX truly special is its atmosphere. It’s a heartwarming adventure that never loses its **** absolute gem of the Nintendo DS era and one of the most memorable JRPGs ever made.
game_title: Dragon Quest IX: Sentinels of the Starry Skies

author: Reydan2A
quote: Pokémon Pokopia is a wonderful surprise. Its charming world, creative gameplay and adorable Pokémon make it an incredibly relaxing and addictive experience. Building habitats, discovering new Pokémon and watching your community grow is genuinely **** main weakness is the repetitive nature of certain tasks and the painfully slow progression towards the endgame, which can sometimes feel like a chore.Despite that, Pokopia is a fantastic experience and one of the best Pokémon spin-offs ever made.

author: Reydan2A
quote: This is how you remake a masterpiece.Ocarina of Time was already one of the greatest adventures in gaming history, and somehow Nintendo managed to make it feel magical all over **** visual overhaul brings Hyrule to life in spectacular fashion, but the real achievement is how beautifully the original atmosphere has been preserved. The orchestral soundtrack takes already iconic compositions to another level, giving familiar locations and emotional moments an entirely new dimension. The addition of voice acting and expanded dialogue also makes the story feel more alive without losing its original **** gameplay improvements are equally welcome. Modernised camera controls, smoother movement and quality-of-life enhancements make exploration and combat feel much more natural. The original puzzles, dungeons and boss encounters remain at the heart of the experience, proving just how brilliant the original game design really was.What makes this remake special is its respect for the source material. Nintendo didn’t try to reinvent everything just for the sake of change. Instead, it understood what made Ocarina of Time legendary and improved almost every aspect without sacrificing its identity.Whether you’re revisiting Hyrule after decades or experiencing this adventure for the first time, the result is extraordinary.A beautiful tribute to one of gaming’s greatest masterpieces. This isn’t just nostalgia. It’s proof that exceptional game design never gets old.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Reydan2A
quote: A timeless masterpiece that helped define what 3D adventure games could be.Ocarina of Time delivers an unforgettable adventure through its incredible soundtrack, memorable story and exceptionally well-designed gameplay. Its music is simply legendary. From the peaceful melodies of Kokiri Forest to the haunting atmosphere of the Shadow Temple, every location has its own identity. And being able to play melodies yourself using the Ocarina is still one of the most charming and memorable mechanics in **** story is much more than a simple adventure about saving a princess. The transition from childhood to adulthood, the consequences of Link’s actions and the transformation of Hyrule give the journey a surprisingly emotional depth. It’s a beautiful tale about time, loss, courage and growing up.Gameplay-wise, Nintendo created something truly revolutionary. The targeting system, exploration, puzzles, dungeons and boss fights all come together brilliantly. Every dungeon feels carefully designed, rewarding curiosity and observation rather than simply testing your reflexes.Even decades later, Ocarina of Time remains an incredible experience. Its influence on the gaming industry is undeniable, but more importantly, it’s still genuinely fun to play today.A legendary soundtrack, an unforgettable adventure and gameplay that helped shape an entire genre. Some games are simply timeless. This is one of them.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Reydan2A
quote: Only 30 FPS, poorly developed character personalities, numerous glitches, fewer NPCs making the world feel strangely empty, and even crashes when saving the game. These are serious issues for a game of this scale. Cyberpunk 2077 was heavily criticized for similar problems at launch. But apparently, because this game is called GTA, we’re supposed to give it a pass? No, that’s not how it **** low rating reflects my disappointment after years of anticipation. Realistically, the game probably deserves a 5 or 6 out of 10. However, when a game is marketed by the press as a masterpiece after 13 years of development, expectations are understandably much higher. That has to be reflected in my score.I can’t give it a 0 like some review bombers, because the game is still fun. But let’s be honest: I could also have fun playing GTA V or countless other games available today. After 13 years of development, I expected much more.
